queries.name: integer
queries.sql: SELECT i FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,1000)) AS t(i) ORDER BY i

queries.name: float
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(i AS DOUBLE)/7 FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,1000)) AS t(i) ORDER BY i

queries.name: decimal
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(i AS DECIMAL(18,4))/CAST(7 AS DECIMAL(18,4)) FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,1000)) AS t(i) ORDER BY i

queries.name: date-time
queries.sql: SELECT CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE), CAST('2026-09-30 23:59:59.123456' AS DATETIME) FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,1000)) AS t(i)

queries.name: nested
queries.sql: SELECT [i,i+1,NULL],map('a',i,'b',i+1),json_object('v',i) FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,1000)) AS t(i) ORDER BY i

queries.name: wide
queries.sql: SELECT i,repeat('x',4096) FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,100)) AS t(i) ORDER BY i

queries.name: wide-slow
queries.sql: SELECT i,repeat('x',4096) FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,100)) AS t(i) ORDER BY i

queries.name: count
queries.sql: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT i FROM TABLE(generate_series(1,1000)) AS t(i)
